ITEM.PTXT: Compared with a conventional stepped A/T, driving close to the optimum fuel economy line (a preset high-torque range with good fuel consumption rate) is possible, drawing out the maximum engine performance. In addition, by expanding the lock-up range to the low speed side, the high-efficiency range can be used during acceleration and the fuel cut range can be expanded during deceleration, contributing to low fuel consumption. The wide gear ratio range lowers engine speed during high-speed driving by making use of the high gear, achieving excellent fuel economy.
